channel.title: Futzs — Blog
channel.description: Google Workspace apps and open-source tools that remove small, repeated friction from your working day.

item.title: Why Futzs sponsors PyCon Togo
item.description: Futzs is a bronze sponsor of PyCon Togo 2026 in Lomé, 28–30 August. Why a small Google Workspace shop puts money into an African Python conference.
item.author: contact@futzs.com (Serge Koudoro)

item.title: Why your Google Calendar subscription is not updating
item.description: A subscribed iCal calendar showing stale or missing events is usually not broken. The refresh behaviour behind it, and how to tell slow from actually broken.
item.author: contact@futzs.com (Serge Koudoro)

item.title: Syncing an Outlook calendar into Google Calendar
item.description: Publish your Outlook or Microsoft 365 calendar as an iCal (.ics) feed, then sync it into Google Calendar. What each option does, and where the delay comes from.
item.author: contact@futzs.com (Serge Koudoro)

item.title: Sharing one iCal feed across a whole team
item.description: Sending an .ics URL to twelve colleagues gives you twelve subscriptions, each stale at a different moment. Sync it once into a shared Google Calendar instead.
item.author: contact@futzs.com (Serge Koudoro)

item.title: Pulling an external calendar into Google Calendar, properly
item.description: Google Calendar refreshes an iCal subscription on its own schedule, often 12 to 24 hours behind. Here is what actually happens, and how realtime iCal sync fixes it.
item.author: contact@futzs.com (Serge Koudoro)

item.title: Why we build Workspace add-ons in Python
item.description: Apps Script is the default answer for Workspace add-ons and a fine one. Here is what we gained by moving the add-on layer to Python, and what it cost.
item.author: contact@futzs.com (Serge Koudoro)
